description: This file contains unit tests for the ConceptService in the OpenMRS project, focusing on testing various methods related to concepts, concept mapping, concept sources, and associated entities. It extends a base test class designed for context-sensitive tests, and uses JUnit 5 for test execution and Hamcrest matchers for assertions.
